text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Under the Account Closure Procedure v1.4, the key steps are: (1) Verify the member's identity using two forms of ID in branch or three-factor authentication by phone; (2) Obtain a signed Form HCU-ACL-220 from every account owner; (3) Review pending items, holds and scheduled transfers; (4) Cancel debit cards, stop recurring transfers and remove bill pay payees; (5) Move the account to Closing status; (6) Complete pending items review; (7) Disburse remaining balance and set account to Closed; (8) Send closure confirmation letter. For timelines: the remaining balance is disbursed by official check mailed within 7 business days. Phone requests are accepted for single-owner accounts only, with the signed form required by mail or secure upload before step 5 can be completed. Note: If the Primary Share Account is closed, the member's membership ends, and if the account is overdrawn, closure cannot be completed.", "cited_chunk_ids": ["account_closure_procedure::layout::B_structure::0002", "account_closure_procedure::layout::B_structure::0001", "account_closure_procedure::layout::B_structure::0004"], "reason": "The passages provide detailed steps and timelines for the account closure process for retail members, including the eight-step procedure and the 7 business day disbursement timeline."}
